source_note: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0
english_source_note: Lp Decay Rates Ensuring Almost Everywhere Convergence to 0
callout_id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#7
statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of random variables on a probability space \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, P)\) such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^2} \to 0\), and suppose the series of variances \(\sum_{n\ge 1} \mathrm{Var}(f_n)\) converges. Then \(f_n\) converges to \(0\) almost surely.
callout_body: 设$f_n$是概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上的一个随机变量$||f_n||_{L^2}\to 0$，并且$f_n$的方差形成的级数收敛那么此随机变量几乎处处收敛到0。
